paragraphs.text: Visual per-model context-window adjustment for WorkBuddy and Trae connectors in DeepSeek Harness
# dsh-context-windows

A DeepSeek Harness client plugin that adds a **Settings → 模型上下文窗口 / Model Context
Windows** page, gi

ving WorkBuddy and Trae the same per-model visual context-window
adjustment that Qoder CN has under
its own Settings section.
## What it does

- Lists the models of each connected WorkBuddy / Trae region on one page.
- For each model, offers a

`<select>` of context-window sizes (plus a "default /
follow upstream" option that clears the overr

ide).
- Writes the chosen value into the connector's existing `contextBudgets` config
field via the

Host settings service, so the set value actually takes effect
in `applyContextBudgets`.
- Re-fetches

the model roster after each write, so the effective (advertised)
window proves the change round-tri

pped.
- Bilingual (zh / en) via the Host locale service; uses proven theme tokens and
self-paints an
opaque background so it is readable on glass themes.
## Honest limitations (stated in the UI)

A budget only changes the **context window DSH advertises** for the model, which
drives **auto-compr

ession timing**. It does **not** change the window the upstream
service actually serves for a reques

sion timing**. It does **not** change the window the upstream
service actually serves for a request.

- **WorkBuddy** applies `Math.min(native, budget)`: any positive value at or
below the native window

is effective, so the page offers a graded "turn it
down" ladder.
- **Trae** accepts only its own de

clared ladder (`dev` / `500K` when
`Max >= 500K` / `Max`). A model that declares no `Max` window has

a single
option and is shown as **read-only** rather than offering a no-op control.
- **Qoder CN**
is left to its own Settings page (it already has this feature).
## Structure
| File | Role |
| `index.js` | Host half: `settings.section`-agnostic loopback routes `GET /plugins/dsh-context-wind
ows/state` and `POST /plugins/dsh-context-windows/set` that read/write `regions[panel].contextBudget

s` through `settings.describe()` / `settings.mutate()`. |
| `client.js` | Browser half: registers th

e `settings.section` page and renders the visual controls. |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Inserts the bund

le into the profile patch. |
| `locale/zh.json`, `locale/en.json` | Host display metadata (`meta.tit

le`, `meta.description`). |
| `icon.svg` | Settings icon. |
The client reads model rosters from each connector's own proven routes:

- `/plugins/dsh-connect-workbuddy/usage?region=cn|global`
- `/plugins/dsh-connect-trae/usage?region=
cn|enterprise|ai&detail=fast`
